title: Washington Park bank slated for demolition (endangered)
description: CCLBA announces intent to sell the Washington Park National Bank Building to DL3/Real Estate / Greenlighting for demolition; Preservation Chicago and Landmarks Illinois list it as endangered; press coverage follows.

title: St. Rita unites with St. Clare of Montefalco
description: Effective July 1, 2020, St. Rita of Cascia Parish officially united with St. Clare of Montefalco Parish under the Archdiocese's Renew My Church process, retaining the St. Rita of Cascia title with St. Rita as the parish church. [6243 S. Fairfield Ave., Chicago Lawn]

title: Whole Foods Englewood closes
description: Whole Foods closed after six years; company cited insufficient 'performance and growth potential.' / Whole Foods Englewood closes after six years.

title: Save A Lot opens in former Whole Foods
description: Yellow Banana-operated Save A Lot opened in the former Whole Foods space after community opposition delayed the April opening.

title: Washington Park National Bank redevelopment approved
description: City Council approved six-story, 72,000-sq-ft mixed-use redevelopment preserving two facades; $5M Community Development Grant; rezoned B3-3 to B3-5. Construction status as of 2026-09-28 unresolved.

title: MPC 'Re-Connecting Communities' report
description: MPC report depicted the Dan Ryan as a 14-lane barrier bisecting South Side communities (Englewood/Washington Park imagery).

title: Referendum supports reopening Racine station
description: 16th Ward advisory referendum passes in support of reopening the Racine Green Line station.

title: CEGU publishes 'A Century on 63rd Street'
description: UChicago's Committee on Environment, Geography and Urbanization published 'A Century on 63rd Street,' a cartographic record of transformations in Englewood and Woodlawn.

title: E.G. Woode small-business hub grand opening (1122 W. 63rd; year unconfirmed)
description: E.G. Woode small-business hub grand opening (1122 W. 63rd; year unconfirmed)
Obama Presidential Center opens near the old Stony Island terminal site; petition movement to restore Green Line service to Jackson Park gains visibility.

title: Englewood sculpture park reported (63rd/May-Racine)
description: Englewood Arts Collective sculpture park reported along 63rd between May and Racine.
